title: How come we can't have dessert?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: We are not having any dessert tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How come we can't have dessert?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Because we already had lots of treats at the party.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But those don't count, I think.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Sugar is still sugar, no matter what.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How come you get to decide for me?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Because I'm the dad, and you have had enough sugar today.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Hmph. Can I have some tomorrow, then?
